title: David's Lament for Saul and Jonathan
summary: An Amalekite reports Saul and Jonathan's deaths at Mount Gilboa and claims to have killed Saul himself, so David has him executed and then composes a lament for both men.

title: David Anointed King over Judah
summary: David moves to Hebron and is anointed king over Judah, while Abner makes Saul's son Ish-bosheth king over the rest of Israel, and their two armies clash at Gibeon.

title: Abner Defects and Is Murdered
summary: War between the house of Saul and the house of David drags on until Abner quarrels with Ish-bosheth and defects, but Joab murders him in revenge for his brother Asahel.

title: Ish-bosheth Is Murdered
summary: Two of Ish-bosheth's own captains assassinate him in his bed and bring his head to David expecting a reward, but David has the murderers executed for killing an innocent man.

title: David Becomes King over All Israel
summary: All the tribes of Israel anoint David king, he captures the Jebusite stronghold of Jerusalem to make it his capital, and he defeats the Philistines twice in the valley of Rephaim.

title: The Ark Comes to Jerusalem
summary: Uzzah dies for touching the ark on its way to Jerusalem, but David later brings it into the city with dancing and celebration, and Michal despises him for it.

title: The Davidic Covenant
summary: David wants to build God a permanent house, but Nathan tells him that instead the LORD will build David a house, promising his throne and kingdom will last forever.

title: David's Victories and Officials
summary: A summary passage lists David's military victories over the Philistines, Moab, Zobah, the Arameans, and Edom, and names the officials he appoints as his kingdom is firmly established.

title: David Shows Kindness to Mephibosheth
summary: For Jonathan's sake, David seeks out any survivor of Saul's house, finds his crippled son Mephibosheth living in Lo-debar, and restores his land while welcoming him to the king's table.

title: War with the Ammonites
summary: Ammon's new king humiliates the envoys David sends to console him, and when the Ammonites hire Aramean mercenaries in response, Joab and Abishai defeat the combined enemy forces in battle.

title: David and Bathsheba
summary: David sees Bathsheba bathing and sleeps with her while her husband Uriah is at war, and when Uriah refuses to cover the pregnancy David has him killed in battle.

title: Nathan's Rebuke and the Birth of Solomon
summary: Nathan confronts David with a parable and tells him he is the guilty man, the child born to Bathsheba dies despite David's pleading, and Solomon is born in his place.

title: Amnon and Tamar
summary: David's son Amnon rapes his half-sister Tamar and then rejects her, and two years later her full brother Absalom avenges her by having Amnon killed at a feast before fleeing.

title: Absalom's Return
summary: Joab sends a wise woman to persuade David to allow the banished Absalom back to Jerusalem, and after two years of estrangement father and son are finally reconciled.

title: Absalom's Rebellion Begins
summary: Absalom wins the loyalty of Israel over four years, has himself proclaimed king, and forces David to flee Jerusalem, though the loyal foreigner Ittai refuses to leave the king's side.

title: Shimei's Curse and Absalom's Advance
summary: As David flees, Ziba deceives him about Mephibosheth and Shimei curses him along the road, while in Jerusalem Absalom publicly claims his father's concubines on Ahithophel's advice.

title: Ahithophel's Counsel Is Rejected
summary: Absalom rejects Ahithophel's advice to attack David immediately in favor of Hushai's plan to delay, and after Hushai's warning reaches David, Ahithophel goes home and hangs himself.

title: The Death of Absalom
summary: David's army defeats Absalom's forces in the forest of Ephraim, Joab kills Absalom after his hair catches in a tree, and a grieving David weeps bitterly for his son.

title: David Returns to Jerusalem
summary: Joab rebukes David for mourning instead of thanking his army, and as David returns he pardons Shimei, settles a dispute over Mephibosheth's land, and honors Barzillai for his loyalty.

title: Sheba's Revolt
summary: A troublemaker named Sheba leads Israel away from David in a new revolt, and after Joab kills the army commander Amasa, the rebellion ends when a wise woman has Sheba beheaded.

title: The Gibeonites Avenged
summary: David hands over seven of Saul's descendants to end a famine caused by Saul's broken oath to the Gibeonites, and his men kill four Philistine giants in renewed fighting.

title: David's Song of Deliverance
summary: David sings a long song of praise to the LORD, celebrating him as a rock and fortress who rescued David from Saul and from every enemy throughout his life.

title: David's Last Words and Mighty Men
summary: David's final recorded words describe a ruler who governs justly, and a closing roster honors his mighty men and their exploits, including three who risked their lives to bring him water.

title: The Census and the Threshing Floor
summary: David orders a census against Joab's advice, and after God sends a plague on Israel, David buys a threshing floor at full price and builds an altar to stop it.
